dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Thanks for inviting me to come down, you two!

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: I must say, I feel like a new man after visiting the park and seeing all those adorable animals.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Seems like Lynette has her eye on some great potential animal assistants, too...

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: Freminet often works with Blubberbeasts anyway, so I think they'd make a great fit.

dialogues.speaker: Lynette
dialogues.text: "Father" has spoken of how obedient and well-behaved squirrels are, so they're a great choice too.

dialogues.speaker: Lyney
dialogues.text: Oh, and did you see those weird mushrooms? Can we take home a few of those as well?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That... might not be possible! These Fungi have been specially trained, y'know. They're like... the stunt actors of the elemental world.

choices.text: If you're after soft and squishy, there are other options.

response.speaker: Lynette
response.text: Okay then, I'll wait for you to bring us a little kitty.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Um, are you sure about that? Paimon's pretty sure we've never seen a cat anywhere near as big and as soft as a Fungus...

choices.text: A nice fluffy cat would fit the bill, too.
